annotations.title: What agents looked for around your MCP server (7Maps)

description: Call when the owner of a map server wants to see how agents looked for servers like theirs. Returns counts only, no agent identities. Read-only. Not for servers you do not own. Example: {"server":"https://mcp.example.com/mcp","days":30}

owner_key.description: The owner key returned to the verified owner by claim_mcp_server (the newest one; each verification issues a new key)

server.description: The MCP server address as it appears on its 7Maps page, or its official registry name
